Print all combinations of two lists using nested loops.

Supplied answer
adjectives = ["red", "big", "tasty"]
fruits = ["apple", "orange", "mango"]
for adj in adjectives:
    for fruit in fruits:
        print(adj, fruit)
Note: The inner loop runs fully for every single turn of the outer loop (3 x 3 = 9 lines).
